events.title: Demo update: easier to read
events.summary: Demo update: easier to read. Thanks to your feedback, the certificate, the memo and the facility rulebook now use larger, clearer text, and the screen effect no longer sits on the paper. Your next shift at the intake desk should be easier on the eyes. Images and music are AI-assisted with human editorial control; text and code are human–AI co-written. — 3Cats Studio, Amsterdam

events.title: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED demo: recorded gameplay
events.summary: A recorded run through the free demo plays here on some evenings (18:00–24:00 CET/CEST) during Steam Next Fest: cases examined, rulings made. It is not live, so a question in chat may wait a while. The demo is free on this page.

events.title: Do not open the bag. Do not speak to it.
events.summary: Hello — this is the first word from us on this page, so it may as well be the job description. You are the new night clerk at a municipal morgue in a city that produces more bodies than it can explain. A bell rings. Paperwork comes through the hatch. Behind the glass, a covered gurney rolls into the intake bay. Your job is simple and it is written down: confirm that the paperwork and the body are the same thing. Read the file — death certificate, transfer manifest, personal effects, a polaroid.
